say:2:1012101001:0.text: This is the Vaduso Mountains. We must find Master Arden as soon as possible.
say:2:1012101001:0.source_cn: 这一片就是瓦度索山脉了，我们必须尽快找到雅顿老爷子。
say:2:1012101001:0.male: This is the Vaduso Mountains. We must find Master Arden as soon as possible.
say:2:1012101001:0.female: This is the Vaduso Mountains. We must find Master Arden as soon as possible.

say:3:1012101002:0.text: Well, Master Arden is known to be a free-spirited soul and doesn't like to stay in one place for too long.
say:3:1012101002:0.source_cn: 雅顿贤者素来随性，不喜欢在一个地方停留太久。

say:4:1012101003:0.text: The message that I sent received no response. I do not know what has happened.
say:4:1012101003:0.source_cn: 发出的风讯至今未回，不知道究竟发生了什么……

say:5:1012101004:0.text: Hey... What's wrong, Bryon? It's not like you to start a journey with such discouraging words...
say:5:1012101004:0.source_cn: 喂……布莱恩，你怎么回事啊？刚刚启程就说丧气话，这可不...

say:6:1012101005:0.text: You know what they say, "If you follow the water, you'll eventually end up in the sea". Sometimes, you just have to let nature take its course. Come on, don't look so depressed. Give me a smile!
say:6:1012101005:0.source_cn: 只要顺水而下，终将归于大海——顺其自然的道理你懂吧？快...

say:7:1012101006:0.text: Forget it... I don't expect you to understand.
say:7:1012101006:0.source_cn: 算了……我并不指望您能理解我的担忧。

say:9:1012101007:2.text: Lorsan's only trying to comfort you, Bryon. He's afraid you'll get yourself into a tizzy. In reality, he's worried too.
say:9:1012101007:2.source_cn: 布莱恩，洛桑是怕你乱了方寸才安慰你的。其实他也很担心。

say:10:1012101008:2.text: Look at his ears. They've been shaking this whole time.
say:10:1012101008:2.source_cn: 你仔细看他的耳朵，他的耳朵一路上都在发抖。

say:14:1012101010:0.text: I've noticed that, too. But it's not only his ears, his tail has been quivering also.
say:14:1012101010:0.source_cn: 我也注意到了。不止耳朵，尾巴也在发抖呢。

say:17:1012101012:0.source_cn: 怎么你也陪着他们逗我啊……

say:18:1012101015:0.text: Alright... Let's leave it at that. We better hurry and get out of here!
say:18:1012101015:0.source_cn: 好了好了……不和你们计较这些，还是快点赶路吧！
say:18:1012101015:0.male: Alright... Let's leave it at that. We better hurry and get out of here!
say:18:1012101015:0.female: Alright... Let's leave it at that. We better hurry and get out of here!

say:19:1012101016:0.text: The village of <style="highlight">Taran</style> is just ahead. Master Arden visits the village occasionally, and the villagers might know something.
say:19:1012101016:0.male: The village of <style="highlight">Taran</style> is just ahead. Master Arden visits the village occasionally, and the villagers might know something.
say:19:1012101016:0.female: The village of <style="highlight">Taran</style> is just ahead. Master Arden visits the village occasionally, and the villagers might know something.

say:23:1012101013:0.text: Really? Lorsan keeps saying that I don't understand him at all... I guess he's just stubborn.
say:23:1012101013:0.source_cn: 有吗？可是洛桑一直说我根本不了解他……难道，他又嘴硬了？
say:23:1012101013:0.male: Really? Lorsan keeps saying that I don't understand him at all... I guess he's just stubborn.
say:23:1012101013:0.female: Really? Lorsan keeps saying that I don't understand him at all... I guess he's just stubborn.
